text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder seems to have made a
strong
impression in her debut race!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm back, Trainer. Are you still feeling
nervous?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Wonderful. ♪ The first step has
been
taken... yes?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After packing up our things to head
back, we step outside only to be
immediately approached by a
waiting
figure.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Grass Wonder! May I ask you
a few
quick questions?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, certainly. Go right ahead.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Then let me start by
congratulating
you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
You displayed amazing potential in your
debut
race! Your running was a sight to
behold!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm honored to receive such praise.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh, trust me, I've still got goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It's no wonder they call you the next

Maruzensky—you really are the Beast's
Successor!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though the reporter's eyes are alight with
excitement, I feel like they're
seeing too much of
Maruzensky and not
enough of Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder herself must be feeling
this
dissonance even more acutely.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Allow me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try to step in, but Grass Wonder cuts
me off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Too excited to notice the tension in the
air, the
reporter tries to press onward
with the interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So, what's in your racing schedule going
forward?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
If you have anything planned, I'd love to
know
what race we'll be seeing you in
next!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh yes, I was just about to discuss that
very topic
with my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So then, Trainer, is now a good time?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, my heart is set on one in particular.
choice_data_list: Is there a race you want to enter?
Is there a race you'd like to enter?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to race in the Asahi Hai
Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai F.S. is well-known to
determine the
top junior-year runner, so
it sounds like a perfect
objective for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But there's just one problem...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Did I hear that right?! The Asahi Hai
F.S.?!
That's...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That's the race where Maruzensky set a
new
record back in her junior year!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: And now you want to run in it next?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, so long as I receive my trainer's
permission.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as it wouldn't put unreasonable
strain on
her schedule, I'd intended to
approve any race
she might name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But this...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Now this is a scoop! "The Successor Aims
for the
Junior Crown!" Yep, this going on
the front page!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your time and the
big
news! Goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Please be careful on your way
home.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now then... just to make sure.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, may I set the Asahi Hai F.S. as
my next
race goal?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky's performance in the Asahi
Hai F.S.
left a mark on the racing world
that still burns
vividly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People are already calling Grass Wonder
the next
Maruzensky. If she makes this
her next big race...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I know.
choice_data_list: People will always see her as just...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That's exactly why I have to enter.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The nickname has already spread, so
there's no
escaping it now.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I have no intention of running
from it
anyhow.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Bring on the comparisons, I say. I'll take
this
chance to prove myself once and for
all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My running is one of a kind.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So... I'll ask one more time.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Do I have your permission to run in the
Asahi Hai
F.S.?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you.
choice_data_list: Let's go show them what you can do!
Let's go show them what you can do!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Then let's begin training right away. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, Grass Wonder's next goal
is
decided: the Asahi Hai Futurity
Stakes!
